text:
This maybe holds coupons, I have no idea!. This was my mistake to order this, as I now have No
Idea what it’s for! But it’s well made.
I thought you put this on your fridge with magnets that this
Comes with two , and I thought it would hold glad wrap box , foil box etc.
I looked for measurements didn’t find any, and
Not much info on this!

This is a small container that doesn’t hold anything, that is 6 inch wide,
8 inch tall that looks like two drawers.
It pulls down but when open its maybe 1/16 th deep!
The out side is less then a1/2 inch.

Maybe it’s to hold coupons,I don’t use those, but
If you do it could work!
